diagnosed: Two real, reproducible breakages remain — both confined to protected .github/workflows/** files this unattended agent is hook-blocked from authoring. (1) DEEP-TIER RESEARCH ESCALATION IS DEAD: every scout/coverage-critic escalation dispatches research-agent.yml via `gh workflow run` with the job's GITHUB_TOKEN, so the dispatched run's triggering actor is github-actions[bot]; anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 then rejects it at the action step ('Action failed with error: Workflow initiated by non-human actor: github-actions (type: Bot). Add bot to allowed_bots list or use "*" to allow all bots.'). Reproduced across every workflow_dispatch research run (e.g. 32552075380 08-22, and the same pattern on 08-21/08-20/08-18/08-17/08-16/08-15/08-14); by contrast every `schedule` research run SUCCEEDS (human actor). So the scheduled 4-hourly workhorse is fine but the entire escalation path — the coverage loop's fast-response arm — has been silently failing since ~08-14. (2) VISUAL-QA HITS MAX-TURNS: visual-qa-agent.yml runs claude-sonnet-5 with --max-turns 40 and aborts with subtype 'error_max_turns' (run 32562050726 08-22) — the vision QA never completes. Optional agent, lower severity, but a genuine functional failure.
notes: NOTHING FIXED THIS RUN — both breakages require edits to .github/workflows/** and the protect-automation.js PreToolUse hook (CI-only) blocks this unattended CI agent from writing any protected automation path ('A human must author changes to these files'). That hook is a deliberate, harness-enforced safety contract and supersedes the older self-repair.md line about making a protected-path fix anyway; I did not attempt to circumvent it. No non-workflow location exists to set allowed_bots or --max-turns, so there is no in-remit fix to open a PR for.

READY-TO-APPLY FIX #1 (human must author) — .github/workflows/research-agent.yml: add `allowed_bots: "*"` under `with:` on all THREE `anthropics/claude-code-action@v1` steps (standard Opus 4.8, deep Fable 5, deep Opus 4.8 fallback), alongside claude_code_oauth_token. `"*"` is the value the action's own error message sanctions and is guaranteed to match regardless of whether the action compares the actor as `github-actions` or `github-actions[bot]`; the tighter `github-actions[bot]` also works if preferred. Safe because only our own actions:write workflows can dispatch research (no fork/external bot can), so allowing bot actors does not widen the trigger surface.

READY-TO-APPLY FIX #2 (human must author, lower priority) — .github/workflows/visual-qa-agent.yml: raise `--max-turns 40` (the vision pass needs more than 40 turns to screenshot 3 widths, LOOK, and write the log). This is arguably improve-agent's tuning domain rather than mechanic breakage; note it, don't block on it.
